valuemapid.description: ID of the value map to update.

hostid.description: Value map host or template ID.

mappings.description: Value mappings for current value map.

type.description: Mapping match type. For type equal 0,1,2,3,4 value field cannot be empty, for type 5 value field should be empty. Possible values: 0 - (default) exact match; 1 - mapping will be applied if value is greater or equal (numeric unsigned/float items only); 2 - mapping will be applied if value is less or equal (numeric unsigned/float items only); 3 - mapping will be applied if value is in range (ranges are inclusive), allows defining multiple ranges separated by comma (numeric unsigned/float items only); 4 - mapping will be applied if value matches regular expression (character items only); 5 - default value, mapping will be applied if no other match were found.

value.description: Original value. Is not required for mapping of type "default".

newvalue.description: Value to which the original value is mapped to.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported value maps to already existing ones. Used only for value maps on templates. Auto-generated, if not given.
